paite: Huchiin, unau siangthou, van sapna tangsamte aw, I thugina Sawltak leh Siampu Lian, Jesu tuh, ngaihtuah un;
english: Therefore, holy brothers, partakers of a heavenly calling, consider the Apostle and High Priest of our confession, Jesus;

paite: Pathian inkuante tengteng lakah Mosi tuh a muanhuai bangmahin, amah tuh a seppa lakah amuanhuai ahi.
english: who was faithful to him who appointed him, as also was Moses in all his house.

paite: Insunga papen tuh ainkuante sanga apahtawi jawk bang ngei un, amah tuh Mosi sanga thupi jawkna sem mu dia kilawma seh a hita ngala.
english: For he has been counted worthy of more glory than Moses, inasmuch as he who built the house has more honor than the house.

paite: Inkuan chihin papen kuahiam bek a nei chiat ngal ua; bangkim papen bel Pathian ahi.
english: For every house is built by someone; but he who built all things is God.

paite: Huan, huai nunga thugen nalai dingte theihsakna dingin, Mosi tuh Pathian inkuante tengteng laka nasempa injaw a muanhuai ngei hi;
english: Moses indeed was faithful in all his house as a servant, for a testimony of those things which were afterward to be spoken,

paite: Kris bel Pathian inkuante tunga Tapa-in a muanhuai ahi. A inkuante tuh eite I hi uhi, atawp tana I hansanna leh I lametna suanna kiptaka I vom hoih photphot leh.
english: but Christ is faithful as a Son over his house; whose house we are, if we hold fast our confidence and the glorying of our hope firm to the end.

paite: Huchiin, Kha Siangthou gen bangin, Tuni a a aw na jak chiangun,
english: Therefore, even as the Holy Spirit says, “Today if you will hear his voice,

paite: Gamdaia zeet na nia hel bang un, na lungtang uh khauh sak kei un;
english: don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion, like as in the day of the trial in the wilderness,

paite: Huailai ah tuh na pi leh pute un honjeet in hon khem ua, kum sawmli sunga ka thil hihte a mu ua;
english: where your fathers tested me by proving me, and saw my works for forty years.

paite: Huchiin huai suan te tungah ka lung hita keia, a lungtangun a ngaihtuah khial gige ua, Kalampite leng a theikei uhi, ka chi a,
english: Therefore I was displeased with that generation, and said, ‘They always err in their heart, but they didn’t know my ways;’

paite: Ka thangpaihna aka kichiam bangin ka khawlna ah alut kei ding uh, chiin.
english: as I swore in my wrath, ‘They will not enter into my rest.’” Psalm 95:7-11

paite: Unaute aw, pilvang un, huchi lou in jaw, Pathian hing tawpsan ding in na lak uah kuapeuh sungah ginlouhna lungtang gilou ahong om kha ding hi.
english: Beware, brothers, lest perhaps there be in any one of you an evil heart of unbelief, in falling away from the living God;

paite: Tuniin achih lai un niteng in ki hasuan tuah jaw un, huchia nalak ua mi kuamah khelhna khemhat jiaka hihkhawla na om louhna ding un,
english: but exhort one another day by day, so long as it is called “today”; lest any one of you be hardened by the deceitfulness of sin.

paite: Kris neite ina hita ngal ua, i ginna pen kipat na tuh a tawptan a kiptaka I vom hoih phot leh,
english: For we have become partakers of Christ, if we hold fast the beginning of our confidence firm to the end:

paite: Tuniin a aw nazak chiangun a hel lai bang un, na lungtang uh khauhsak kei un. a kichih laiteng.
english: while it is said, “Today if you will hear his voice, don’t harden your hearts, as in the rebellion.” Psalm 95:7-8

paite: Ahihleh, kuate ahi ua theinapi a helte? Aigupta akipana Mosi pi pawt tengteng hi lou uhia?
english: For who, when they heard, rebelled? No, didn’t all those who came out of Egypt by Moses?

paite: Huan, kuate tungah ahia, kum sawmli sung a alunghihlouh? Hihkhialte a luang uh gamdaia puk tate tungah hilou hia?
english: With whom was he displeased forty years? Wasn’t it with those who sinned, whose bodies fell in the wilderness?

paite: Huan, thu mangloute kiangah kia loungal kua kiangah ahia a khawlna a lut lou dinga a kichiam?Huchiin, ginlahna jiakin a lut theita kei uh chih I thei uhi.
english: To whom did he swear that they wouldn’t enter into his rest, but to those who were disobedient?

paite: Huchiin, ginlahna jiakin a lut theita kei uh chih I thei uhi.
english: We see that they were not able to enter in because of unbelief.
